title: Viewer-first native video scripts
language: Spanish UI; localized captions in seven languages

smsPolicy.fixture: Synthetic system autofill or one-message consent result using fake bank SMS only; no inbox reading or personal SMS
smsPolicy.configurationException: settings: deliveryPreferenceReturnsToSms disables and re-enables assistance, and restores SMS delivery. First-use records the pre-consent choice.
exemptions: Offline DEMO authorization code 123456 is not SMS.
Native Token BSC generation is not SMS.
Security-question and password entry remain explicit.
smsPolicy.automaticSubmission: Only an approved one-message SMS-only login; keyboard autofill and operations retain Verify.

chapters.goal: Understand the independent-app notice before accepting anything.

beats.title: Privacy before consent
beats.direction: Open the privacy policy; hold the opening explanation for 10 seconds. Return without accepting.

beats.title: Terms are a separate choice
beats.direction: Open terms; hold for 10 seconds. Return; pause 5 seconds with Continue disabled. Check agreement, pause 5 seconds, then Continue.

beats.title: Language selection
beats.direction: Open the language list, hold 6 seconds, choose Spanish, and hold the selected setting for 5 seconds.

chapters.goal: Distinguish local remembered access, simulated biometrics, and bank approval.

beats.title: First remembered login
beats.direction: Show the remember checkbox and explain local biometric protection. Type fictional credentials slowly; hold 5 seconds before login. Pause 8 seconds on the resulting accounts.

beats.title: Biometric unlock
beats.direction: Show the prefilled identity and simulated unlock for 6 seconds. Approve the fixture callback, then hold the resulting account list for 8 seconds.

beats.title: SMS without typing a code
beats.direction: With remembered SMS delivery already selected, leave the empty code field visible for 3 seconds. Inject only the synthetic Android autofill callback. Hold the filled field for 5 seconds; no login replay is allowed yet. Tap Verify, then hold the result for 8 seconds.

beats.title: One-message SMS consent
beats.direction: SMS assistance is enabled. Hold the pending SMS field for 3 seconds. Clearly label the simulated Android one-message consent result, pause 8 seconds before fixture approval. Approve the synthetic bank message; current SMS-only login auto-verifies with no extra Verify tap. Hold authenticated result 8 seconds. Do not pretend a fake overlay is the real Android consent dialog.

chapters.goal: Show the independent security steps and who controls each outcome.

beats.title: Question plus SMS
beats.direction: Enter only the fictional security answer. Leave SMS code empty for 3 seconds; autofill it; hold 5 seconds before Verify. Assert no submission happened during autofill.

beats.title: Device approval
beats.direction: Show the unapproved-device screen for 10 seconds. Do not claim registration or account access.

beats.title: Required setup
beats.direction: Show the password requirements; enter fictional values. Hold mismatch feedback for 5 seconds, then correct it. Hold review for 8 seconds; explicitly submit and explain the return to login for 8 seconds.

beats.title: Registration return stays inside the app
beats.direction: Show device registration requirement, pause 10 seconds on consent. Request registration explicitly. Explain required fresh login, pause 6 seconds on biometric re-entry fixture. Approve biometric callback and hold accounts 8 seconds. No password is retained for silent replay.

chapters.goal: Read balances and currency before taking action.

beats.title: Orient
beats.direction: Start at fictional account overview, not another login. Hold for 5 seconds.

beats.title: Privacy
beats.direction: Hide balances, hold 5 seconds; reveal, hold 5 seconds.

beats.title: Separate currencies
beats.direction: Choose USD and hold 6 seconds. Return to DOP and hold 6 seconds.

beats.title: Scroll and details
beats.direction: Show real swipe direction; pause after each scroll. Open account details and hold account identity/currency/actions for 8 seconds.

chapters.goal: Understand visible records and what the CSV contains.

beats.title: Read/search/filter
beats.direction: Start already signed into the fake bank. Reveal account identity, search and filter with 4-second pauses after changed results.

beats.title: Export
beats.direction: Open the demo CSV Sharesheet, hold 8 seconds, then return. Do not claim an external recipient received it.

chapters.goal: Separate viewing, sharing, and persistent saving.

beats.title: Catalogue
beats.direction: Hold available/unavailable periods for 6 seconds before opening.

beats.title: PDF
beats.direction: Hold the synthetic PDF for 8 seconds. Pause 5 seconds after page/zoom actions. Explain sharing is explicit.

beats.title: Save selection
beats.direction: Select available periods and hold the selection for 6 seconds. Press Save selected. Explain the folder callback is simulated; pause 5 seconds before it and 8 seconds after successful synthetic writes.

chapters.goal: Make the review, money confirmation and SMS verification readable.

beats.title: Offline own-account example
beats.direction: Show source/destination, amount and currency. Hold review 8 seconds. Show a wrong DEMO code once, explain for 6 seconds; correct with DEMO code 123456, then hold the fictional receipt 8 seconds. Demo codes are not SMS.

beats.title: Advanced bank/SMS example
beats.direction: Start in an authenticated fake transfer form. Select recipient/amount, hold quote review 8 seconds, then hold the real-money confirmation dialog for 8 seconds. After confirmation, show empty SMS field 3 seconds, autofill without typing, hold filled field 5 seconds. Tap Verify explicitly; hold the fake-bank receipt 8 seconds.

beats.title: Recipient search
beats.direction: Show the pending/read/search/selection distinction; do not submit a bank transfer.

beats.title: Saved-recipient demo
beats.direction: Show same-bank and other-bank offline examples as separate cases, each with an 8-second review/receipt. Local test authorization is explicitly distinct from SMS.

chapters.goal: Review the service and amount before authorization.

beats.title: Offline service
beats.direction: Hold bill/amount review 8 seconds and fictional receipt 8 seconds; the DEMO code remains a local test code.

beats.title: Advanced SMS
beats.direction: Start in the fake-bank payment form. Read review and money confirmation for 8 seconds each. Empty SMS field 3 seconds, autofill callback, filled field 5 seconds, explicit Verify, fake receipt 8 seconds.

chapters.goal: A scanned/pasted recipient is not automatically validated or saved.

beats.title: Code review
beats.direction: Paste the long fictional recipient payload as one paste, not dozens of seconds of character typing. Hold the decoded recipient/currency for 8 seconds before continuation.

beats.title: Deletion with SMS
beats.direction: Read deletion review for 8 seconds; confirm separately. Use SMS autofill only, hold before Verify, then explain the fake bank response for 8 seconds.

beats.title: Local save
beats.direction: Create a clearly fictional other-bank recipient locally, then hold the saved result for 8 seconds. This is a separate offline scene.

chapters.goal: Pause before changing controls, reporting a loss, or sending travel details.

beats.title: Read-only details and unavailable services
beats.direction: Open an actual native fake-bank card. Read status and available bank fields for 8 seconds. Reveal exact card identifier and copy it; explain this is not a reconstructed PAN. Hold missing-full-number explanation. Open Manage card and hold unimplemented-services explanation 12 seconds. No card write or administration request is sent. Return to details and hold 6 seconds.

chapters.goal: Consent and bank approval precede any active code.

beats.title: Contract and proof
beats.direction: Hold synthetic contract 10 seconds. Hold consent explanation 8 seconds before enrollment. Hold pending proof 10 seconds; a fixture approval is explicitly simulated.

beats.title: Active and unlink
beats.direction: Hold generated fictitious code/status 8 seconds. Hold unlink confirmation 8 seconds before accepting, and explain result for 8 seconds.

beats.title: SMS enrollment step
beats.direction: A separate fake enrollment challenge uses SMS autofill, never typed SMS. Show empty/filled/Verify as in other banking scenes. Do not claim this scenario itself completed enrollment. A generated Token BSC code remains a token, not an SMS.

chapters.goal: Review the request before sharing or acting on it.

beats.title: Create and save
beats.direction: Hold account versus payment-request modes; type short fictional purpose/amount readably. Hold completed QR card/details 8 seconds. Demonstrate save cancellation and retry without pretending a bank payment occurred.

beats.title: Scanner review
beats.direction: Hold injected decoded amount/purpose/currency 8 seconds before explicit recipient review. No real camera capture is claimed.

beats.title: Print
beats.direction: Hold Android print preview 8 seconds, return without claiming physical printing.

chapters.goal: Show configuration once, restore SMS, and preserve uncertain outcomes.

beats.title: Delivery configuration
beats.direction: Read one-message SMS consent guidance for 10 seconds. Switch SMS assistance off and hold 6 seconds; switch back on and hold 8 seconds. Then demonstrate Ask and Email delivery preferences with 6-second pauses and restore SMS delivery. All other chapters keep assistance enabled, except the initial pre-choice onboarding scene.

beats.title: Demo settings
beats.direction: Show profile, security, help and logout with 6-second explanation holds.

beats.title: Uncertain operation
beats.direction: Hold the blocked state/history for 10 seconds. Read reconciliation acknowledgement for 10 seconds before checking it. Confirm explicitly and hold result 8 seconds. Never imply retrying, cancelling or reversing the old operation.

overview.direction: 13 eight-second excerpts, one per chapter. Choose stable review/result/filled-code screens; do not splice a new action into its final second. Do not accelerate source footage.
